mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS my_recipe_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_like WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS like_recipe_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_board WHERE users_id = #{userId}) AS my_review_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_board_reply WHERE users_id = #{userId}) AS my_reply_cnt FROM DUAL

SELECT rb.id, rb.subject, rb.content, rb.image_url, rb.hit, rb.created_at, rb.rcp_seq, r.rcp_nm, r.att_file_no_main FROM review_board rb LEFT OUTER JOIN recipe r ON rb.rcp_seq = r.rcp_seq WHERE rb.users_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rb.id DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT rb.id, rb.subject, rb.content, rb.image_url, rb.hit, rb.created_at, rb.rcp_seq,
r.rcp_nm, r.att_file_no_main
FROM review_board rb LEFT OUTER JOIN recipe r ON rb.rcp_seq = r.rcp_seq WHERE rb.users_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rb.id DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY
SELECT id, review_board_id, content, created_at FROM review_board_reply WHERE users_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY
